projects.role: responsible for analyzing the request ideas from my boss. Data and functions are designed and developed by me.
projects.description: E-space is a product startup education of Paxcreation company. It’s a product that my boss brought from Japan to develop and operate in Vietnam. After 3 years of operation, E-space separated from the Paxcreation company to operate separately. E-space had been in development and operation for 8 years. Project ideas We hire foreign teachers to open class schedules on E-space. We will divide the lesson into a 10-class, 20-class, 30-class package and resell it to students. Each session on E-space has 25 minutes and 50 minutes. Each time, students will go to the E-space system such as App, Website to book class schedules through the system. At class, students will join the teacher through the live stream online platform. Build System: We started a project with 2 people to build a system. The product was finished in 3 months, including basic functions such as: Teacher opening class schedule, closing class schedule, students setting a class schedule, canceling a class schedule … After the project came into operation, I was responsible for developing the extended functions until now. Function system: Sell and pay the package via E-space by integrating payment functions. Manage the opening of the teacher's schedule, teacher's hours, the quality of the teacher's teaching. Manage class schedules, cancellations and purchased packages. System livestream, chat, record video during teaching. Export payroll reports by month, Export revenue calculation report Export reports calculating the number of students enrolled monthly The system to build to manage teaching and booking. The system can record and output video after student and teacher class finishes. E-space system includes page basic functions: Teacher page is page for teacher Student page is page for student Company page is page for company Admin page is setting system Backend page is page for employees App for student Iphone/Ipad, Android, Windows App for teacher Iphone/Ipad, Android, Windows
